sources.prompt: Desktop wallpaper, 3:2 landscape. On the right side, a gigantic sleepy calico cat (white body with large orange and dark grey-brown patches, pink inner ears, closed eyes, tiny smile) is curled up asleep, softly lit by the glowing light ribbons, with its tail curling into one of the light streaks, as if it were part of the glow. Keep EXACTLY the same sleeping cat drawing: identical pose, silhouette, body shape, proportions, size and position in the frame, the same thick dark cocoa outline, closed sleepy eyes, whiskers, tiny pink nose and smile, pink inner ears, chin resting on the tucked front paws, and the long tail hanging straight down on the left. Do not move, resize, rotate or redraw the cat.

Change ONLY the fur colours and markings so the cat becomes: a hairless Sphynx cat: smooth warm pink-peach skin with a few soft grey-lavender skin patches and gentle wrinkles on the forehead, large pink ears and a pink tail.

Flat matte colours and the same cute rounded sticker style, a few simple markings that read clearly at 96 pixels wide. Background: perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00ff00 everywhere outside the cat, and no green anywhere in the cat. No text, shadow, glow, props, extra cats or border.
sources.processing: Chroma green removed and despilled; the cat was cropped and resized onto the calico cutout's exact 384x308 box so every coat shares its pose and placement. Lossless WebP.

sources.prompt:
Edit the reference image: fold only the large foreground ear (the ear nearer the viewer, on the left of the head) sideways towards the left by about 25 degrees as a sleepy ear flick, so its tip droops back and down. Keep that ear's own fur colours and markings, its pink inner ear and the thick dark outline.

Everything else stays pixel-identical: the same cat, pose, proportions, position and size in the frame, the same fur colours and markings, the other ear, closed eyes, whiskers, paws and the hanging tail. Do not move, resize or redraw the rest of the cat.

Background: perfectly uniform solid chroma green #00ff00 everywhere outside the cat, and no green anywhere in the cat. No text, motion lines, shadow, glow or border.
sources.processing: Chroma green removed; only the folded foreground ear region was composited into the base coat frame. All pixels outside the ear remain from the base. Lossless WebP alternate frame; tap displays it briefly then restores the base.
